[FMLA 08] MagneticForce — Magnetic Force

Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.

Calculator scroll name: MagneticForce. Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.

formula
F=IℓBsinθ

A current in a magnetic field feels a sideways shove. The sin θ factor is 1 when the wire is perpendicular to B, and 0 when it runs parallel to B (no shove).

keys
FMLA→0→8

Primary inputs: I, B, ℓ, θ (that prompt order).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 0, then 8 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 0 → 8
  2. 3 EXE 0.7 EXE 1 EXE 30 EXE
  3. F = 1.05 N
note

θ is in degrees (0° ≤ |θ| ≤ 90°). Run in Deg. SI units: I in A, B in T, ℓ in m, F in N.
